detail: seeds 1..1500, 120 random ops each (180000 ops: spills from every source and fluid incl. bad amounts and fluid 0, pulses, burns, hand-overs, connected and whole purges) on random worlds (open/blocked/door/grate/receiver/sink, soak, evaporation, frost, boil, partial engine credit): after every op the ledger In == Standing + Returned + JoinedLake + Soaked + Evaporated + Burned + Purged closes to the dL; no negative, over-cap or orphan cell; no sheet on a cell that cannot hold one; wet cells == WetCount <= MaxWetCells; a spill never changes the liquid of a wet cell
400 random worlds saved at a random pulse and loaded: the loaded copy and the uninterrupted run, fed the same later spills, end with the same state hash and the same receiver credits
PreviewSpill equals what ResolveSpills then accepts for the same offer; three offers in two caller orders give the same state and per-offer acceptance

5 cm over a walled 6x6 yard poured nearest-first from one corner (accepted 36000 of 36000 dL), 400 pulses, no losses: 36 of 36 squares wet, surface (dL + relief) spread 1 dL over the unclamped squares (level means <= 1)
2 cm over 4x4 squares with soak 0.9 dL and evaporation 0.3 dL a pulse: dry after 460 pulses; soaked 4806 + evaporated 1594 == poured 6400
days slider 0.5..30 x flow pulse 60..2500 ticks: the crop delay stays the chosen time, rounded up to one pulse; shipped default 1680 stored pulses at 250 ticks = one week

5 cm standing on one square, delay 50 pulses: first reported drowning at pulse 50 (want 50); 2.5 cm poured on dry ground (a film) reported as standing: False (want false); a crop younger than the delay, or a square stood 49 pulses, spared: True
10 cm at -5 C over soaking ground: ice keeping every dL, nothing moved (True); at +0.5 C still ice (True); at +1.0 C thawed, ledger closed (True)
a door between a 20 cm pool and dry ground, leak 0 %: door square 0 dL, far side 0 dL after 2000 pulses (want both 0 for good)
a door between a 20 cm pool and dry ground, leak 5 %: door square 374 dL, far side 3 dL after 4 pulses (want a slow leak, more than 3 pulses)
64 switch combinations: a spill enters only with the depth engine, a known liquid, and (forced or (the master and inflow switch on, and water or 'every liquid spills' on))

RM_SheetSettings.sheetOverflowEnabled ships OFF; its comment says the default stays OFF until the feature's live acceptance signs it off (owner card D7: on once validated). With it off, a fresh game shows none of inv_overflow_sheet's overspill. Lane 2 weighs whether this blocks the bar.

retention 0.5..5 cm x cap 5..100 cm x sweeps 1..6 x door 0..50 % x max wet squares 1..20000 (the shipped slider ends, SyncParams' conversion), 6 random 60-op runs each: every invariant of L1_RANDOM_SHEET_LEDGER_AND_INVARIANTS holds

creeping spills (tar) light a given neighbour in 1500/speed ticks at any check length, vanilla grass-fire pace; chance stays in [0, 1]. A zero check length gives NaN ticks (callers must not pass 0; lane 2 reads them)

converter multiplier 0.1..5 (shipped 1) x 30 random recipes and rates, 10 days of rare ticks with input and room to spare, budget capped and clipped income carried as the kernel documents: input used within one tick's income plus two batches of the 10-day income, never above it
2000 random recipes left dry a week, then filled: the first tick runs no more than one tick's income plus one batch (seed 20261127)

20000 random Batches calls never exceed budget, input or room and run nothing for a bad recipe; 5000 random input sets: rotation reaches every runnable input once per round, none when none can run, and a blocked round keeps the largest cap; a solar still runs only in daylight, unroofed

at the shipped rate x1: full to empty in 1.25 d; heat up to 3x and off with its switch; a 1.5 L bottle restores 0.5; dehydration kills 3.34 d after empty (ruled about 3) and heals with thirst switched off
rate 0.25..3 x heat on/off x hard labour x asleep: the fall is 0.8 x rate x heat x 1.3 x 0.5 per day, 400 need intervals a day; days-of-water readout agrees

every use class x thirst level x humanlike x native x salt break x last-resort switch: potable always, never never, last resort only when empty and allowed, salt only in its break, animals any native water; quality off makes every drinkable potable; salt break gate; awkward access as the owner ruled

30000 random triples: the drink pick is a strict order (use class, then not awkward, then quality, then nearer); 5000 random draws never touch the potable reserve (shipped 200 L = 2000 units); bottles-to-fill = target x colonists - held (shipped target 3), 0 at target 0; need categories (seed 4242)

four looks for bottle, bucket and barrel; each style name round-trips to its look and nothing else reads as one; every tech level wears a look; an unstyled stack joins a styled one, never the reverse, and two looks never merge

placement refuses a surveyed dry or spent square and allows unsurveyed ground (owner card 2026-10-22); the why-not answer over all 4096 x 2 fact sets is None exactly when every condition holds, 'disabled in settings' first, and agrees with placement
20000 random drill writes: the reserve is charged the decilitres that landed in the outlet, in level units, never negative (seed 777)

every switch, pressure, liquid, clog, cell and supply combination: a head sprays only when enabled, switched on, pressured by a pump on its net, holding a sprayable liquid, with cells and the whole pulse paid; with no pump it says NoPressure
litres per cell-hour 0.1..5 in 0.05 (shipped 0.5): a pulse costs cells x litres rounded up, never free or short; the most cells a supply pays for is the true maximum

20000 random fields (seed 99): the thirst valve waters only cells where water changes growth, nearest first, within the day's budget and above the reserve, and as many as those allow; the head sprays the liquid its net holds most of (ties by name); a paid pulse keeps a cell wet to the next pulse plus 250 ticks and a fruiting crop spends it
64 saved settings in the sheet, thirst, sprinkler and machinery files: each field's initializer equals its Scribe default (a fresh install and a loaded save start alike)
